sentences.text:
Mr. S.K. Jena, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party
 Mr. Manoj Kumar Mohanty, Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
 Order
Order No. 19.10.2023
01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Talcher P.S. Case No.425 of 2023 corresponding to Spl. (POCSO) Case No.54 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (under POCSO Act), Angul for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 450/366/368/376(3)/378/323/294/506 and 34 of IPC read with Section 4(2)/6(1)/17 of the POCSO Act and Section 9/11 of the Prohibition of the Child Marriage Act.

entities.text: Prohibition of the Child Marriage Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. It is alleged that one Prem Naik forcibly committed sexual intercourse on the victim.
The Petitioners are the co-villagers of said Prem Naik.
Nothing specific has been attributed to them.

5. Considering the above fact and the nature of accusations and also the materials on record, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioners to surrender before the Court below within a week from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
